health_checks.name: Cryptographic SHA-256 Chain Integrity
health_checks.plain: Every published prediction batch carries a SHA-256 fingerprint, and each fingerprint also hashes the one before it. That means nobody can quietly edit an old entry: the moment a single character changes, the whole chain stops recomputing.

health_checks.name: Out-of-Sample Zero-Lookahead Guard
health_checks.observed: every epoch scored on data frozen at its own cutoff
health_checks.threshold: no post-cutoff information in any feature
health_checks.plain: Each vintage is scored only on information that existed on the day it was taken, then graded against what actually happened later. It is the only way to know a score is real rather than hindsight.

health_checks.name: Manager Breakout Lift > 2.0x
health_checks.plain: If you back the top tenth of managers our score ranks, you hit real breakout companies more than twice as often as picking at random from the same universe. Industry rankings manage roughly 1.4x to 1.9x.

health_checks.name: Startup Breakout Lift (ARCHE™) > 4.5x
health_checks.plain: Among startups scored before they exited, the top tenth produced large exits about 4.7 times more often than chance. The published industry benchmark for the same task is 1.66x.

health_checks.name: Pension IRR Alpha Verified (+11.28%)
health_checks.threshold: > 0 percentage points on official LP disclosures
health_checks.plain: On the official public pension disclosures, partnerships sitting in the top half of our ranking earned 18.72% net IRR against 7.45% for the rest. The alpha is measured on money the pension actually reported, not on a back-test.

health_checks.name: Monotonic Decile Calibration (D10 vs D1 = 27.1x)
health_checks.threshold: each decile must beat the one below it
health_checks.plain: Rank the book into ten buckets and the chance of a breakout has to rise cleanly from bucket to bucket. Ours does: 1.77% in the worst bucket, 32.78% in the best. That is a 27.06x gap you can read straight off the table.

health_checks.name: Automated Cloud Heartbeat Active
health_checks.observed: daily scheduled pulse committed to the public repository
health_checks.plain: A scheduled job re-verifies the whole ledger every day and commits the result back to this repository. If the numbers ever stopped adding up, the green light would go red on its own without anyone pressing a button.

methodology.outcome_definition: A dated acquisition of a company first funded after the cohort cutoff, valued at or above USD 100,000,000, inside the three-year forward window.
methodology.outcome_definition_note: Only exits from companies the manager first funded AFTER the cutoff are graded. Exits from older holdings are shown alongside the misses for transparency, but they are not counted as hits, because a pre-cutoff holding could not have been predicted by a pre-cutoff ranking.
methodology.no_cherry_picking_statement: Every number below is a property of the complete frozen bucket. No pick is dropped, no miss is hidden and no cohort is re-cut after the outcome is known.

buckets.rankable_note: This methodology cannot rank a manager that has no pre-cutoff track record at all: 0 of the 1002 zero-prior-exit managers carry any pre-cutoff signal, so it leaves the entire cohort at the cohort floor and produces no top decile at all.

competitor_wins_flagged.metric: Mean binary manager AUC across the 4 rolling cutoffs (2005/2007/2010/2012)
competitor_wins_flagged.why: A scale league ranks by aggregate capital deployed, which is a strong proxy for how many shots a mega-fund takes. Our composite deliberately penalises book redundancy, so it trades a little binary separation for a much better per-deal exit rate.

improvement_roadmap.title: Elite-Sponsor Round-Velocity Relaxation
improvement_roadmap.rule: When rounds_pre <= 2 and the peak sponsor strength is >= 90, floor the round-velocity and funding-scale components at the top-decile hit median instead of the cohort base: round_velocity' = max(round_velocity, median_hit_round_velocity), funding_scale' = max(funding_scale, median_hit_funding_scale).
improvement_roadmap.evidence: 7 of the 12 biggest startup misses have <= 2 pre-cutoff rounds AND a peak sponsor strength >= 90; 12 have <= 2 rounds in total and 3 have a funding-scale component of effectively zero.
improvement_roadmap.expected_effect: Lifts the elite single-round names (messaging, games, advertising) back over the top-decile cutoff without touching the 95% of the universe that is not elite-sponsored.
improvement_roadmap.risk: Re-opens the door to capital-stage hype. Must be re-validated on all four rolling cutoffs before it ships, and only with a hard sponsor-strength gate.

improvement_roadmap.title: Lagging-Indicator Rebalance: Exit Opportunity Yield
improvement_roadmap.rule: Cap the composite weight of the Exit Opportunity Yield pillar at its current value and move the freed weight onto Bayesian Selection Alpha, because realised exit liquidity is a lagging indicator of the very exits we are trying to predict.
improvement_roadmap.evidence: In the 12 manager winners we ranked outside the top decile while a competitor ranked them inside, Exit Opportunity Yield was the single largest pillar shortfall in 6 cases (Sector Momentum Alignment 1, Capital Deployment Power 4).
improvement_roadmap.expected_effect: Recovers mega-fund and crossover funds whose books were already in sectors that later produced winners, without loosening the redundancy discipline that drives per-deal lift.
improvement_roadmap.risk: Weakening a pillar that works on the emerging cohort could cost coverage there. Re-run the zero-prior-exit sub-cohort before and after.

improvement_roadmap.title: Scale-Efficiency Blend (close the binary AUC gap)
improvement_roadmap.rule: Publish a blended ranking: blended = 0.85 x SOPHIA(TM) composite percentile + 0.15 x capital-scale percentile, so the platform keeps its per-deal efficiency while closing the binary separation gap against the scale league.
improvement_roadmap.evidence: In the 2012 top decile the scale league returns 50/144 binary hits against 44/144 for SOPHIA™ Composite Index. Its mean binary AUC is 0.7494 against 0.733 for us, yet our mean per-deal exit-rate lift is 2.0551x against 1.8292x for the scale league.

improvement_roadmap.expected_effect: Closes most of the binary AUC gap without giving up the per-deal exit-rate advantage that is the platform's actual edge.
improvement_roadmap.risk: This is a hypothesis, not a validated model. It must be re-scored on all four rolling cutoffs and only promoted if it lifts mean AUC without lowering mean per-deal lift.

sealed_tracking_explainer.title: Freeze the bucket
sealed_tracking_explainer.body: At the cohort date we write down every single name we ranked, from rank 1 to the bottom of the universe, and the Top-10% cut line. That list is complete before any outcome is known.

sealed_tracking_explainer.title: Hash the list
sealed_tracking_explainer.body: The frozen list is reduced to a SHA-256 fingerprint. Once that fingerprint is published, a single character of the list cannot be changed without the hash stopping recomputing.

sealed_tracking_explainer.title: Wait for the window to close
sealed_tracking_explainer.body: Nothing is graded until the three-year forward window has closed. No early exit is pulled forward and no late exit is allowed in, so the result cannot be massaged.

sealed_tracking_explainer.title: Grade every pick, hit or miss
sealed_tracking_explainer.body: Every single pick is graded: hits and misses together. We publish the full bucket -- hits, misses, winners missed outside the bucket and the share of all market exits -- so the miss rate is visible next to the hit rate.

reconciliation.note: Every bucket size and exit count in this module is recomputed from the per-entity forward outcome records. A divergence against the published artefact is reported here rather than hidden; where present it is a tie-break difference at the cut line, not a different universe.

prediction_timeline.title: Prediction vs. Reality Timeline Ledger (Zero Guesswork)
prediction_timeline.rule: row_hash = SHA-256( entity | method | sealed_date | claim ) -- recompute it and the published fingerprint reproduces exactly.
